**Build's clean.** Exit 0, `0 errors`.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump, not just noise:

1. [`src/core/options.js`](src/core/options.js) — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
2. [`src/net/retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — `isBackoffEnabled` only handled `true`/`false`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`. Now treated as `false` (disabled).

Rest of the log is genuine noise: `DEP0142`/`DEP0198`/etc deprecation warnings, unused-export and circular-import notices. 8 warnings remain, all cosmetic.

Next: nothing. Build passes.
